provider.name: MolluscaBase
provider.organization_type: global molluscan taxonomy, nomenclature, synonymy, classification, distribution, traits, bibliography, persistent-identifier, API, download, and editorial infrastructure
provider.description: MolluscaBase is a global, expert-curated taxonomic database for molluscs. It provides accepted and unaccepted scientific names, authorship, classification, synonyms, type information, vernacular names, environments, fossil status, distributions, attributes, references, editorial notes, persistent AphiaIDs, external identifier mappings, downloads, and access through the WoRMS REST services.
institutional_context: MolluscaBase editorial board and taxonomic specialist network
Global malacological, museum, biodiversity-informatics, conservation, and nomenclatural communities

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting MolluscaBase documentation, scientific and common names, nomenclature, classifications, synonyms, type information, environments, distributions, traits, references, AphiaIDs, external identifiers, editors, workflows, APIs, downloads, schemas, licenses, citations, institutions, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: MolluscaBase, WoRMS, the editorial board, official releases, official REST documentation, cited publications, nomenclatural sources, and partner datasets remain authoritative for names, status, classification, identifiers, versions, legal conditions, and contact information.
